from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from hashlib import sha256
import json,re
root=Path('products/distribution/invoice-referral-fit')
class Visible(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.hidden=0
        self.parts=[]
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        if tag in {'script','style','template'}:
            self.hidden+=1
    def handle_endtag(self,tag):
        if tag in {'script','style','template'}:
            self.hidden=max(0,self.hidden-1)
    def handle_data(self,data):
        fragment=' '.join(data.split())
        if not self.hidden and fragment:
            self.parts.append(fragment)
sources=[('raw/zoho-books-invoice-help.html','https://www.zoho.com/us/books/help/invoice/',r'csv|import invoice|importing invoice|map fields|sample file|create invoice'),('live-invoice-homepage.html','https://globalland-invoice-preflight.global-land.workers.dev/',r'csv|structur|diagnostic|anonym|autonom')]
results=[]
for name,url,pattern in sources:
    path=root/name
    if not path.is_file():
        results.append({'url':url,'state':'CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE_IN_JOB_INPUTS'})
        continue
    raw=path.read_bytes()
    parser=Visible()
    parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'))
    hits=[i for i,text in enumerate(parser.parts) if re.search(pattern,text,re.I)]
    starts=sorted(hits,key=lambda i: not bool(re.search(r'csv|import',parser.parts[i],re.I)))[:18]
    windows=[{'text_fragment_index':i,'fragments':parser.parts[max(0,i-1):i+2]} for i in sorted(starts)]
    results.append({'url':url,'capture':str(path),'sha256':sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'matching_fragments':len(hits),'windows':windows})
out=root/'workflow-evidence.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Text excerpts for workflow verification. No Zoho import was executed. No affiliate eligibility or economics are established here.','sources':results},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact':str(out),'sources':[{k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='windows'} for row in results]}))
